user.title: Set up Familienplan
user.description: Four short steps and you are ready to go.

members.title: Who is in the family?
members.description: Tick everyone who takes part. Phones for reminders are detected automatically.

data_description.extra_children: Optional, comma separated, e.g. Lucas, Osmo.

parents.title: Who are the parents?
parents.description: Parents can create and approve chores. Everyone else is a child.

chores.title: What do you want to start with?
chores.description: Suggestions that suit your children's ages. Shared chores rotate, children who are too young are skipped. Add your own chores afterwards in the sidebar under Familienplan → Chores.

ages.title: How old are the children?
ages.description: Age in years. Each child only gets chores that suit their age and automatically moves into new chores as they grow older. You can leave it empty.

rewards.title: Which rewards are there?
rewards.description: Children earn points with completed chores and redeem them here. You confirm every redemption. Add your own rewards and prices later under Familienplan → Rewards.

photos.title: Photos and privacy
photos.description: For chores with photo proof, children take a photo that only parents can see. Photos stay in your Home Assistant and never leave it. You decide per chore whether photo proof is needed; it is off by default.

error.no_members: Please select or enter at least one family member.

data_description.user: Links this member to a login, so permissions are checked when they use the app.

data_description.reminder_times: Comma separated, e.g. 15:00, 17:00, 18:30. Only sent if something is still open.

consequences.title: Internet lock
consequences.description: When a child still has overdue chores during the lock window, the internet of their chosen devices is switched off. It comes back as soon as everything is done, or at the end of the window. Do not add phones.

devices_select.title: Devices for {member}
devices_select.description: Choose the internet switches of leisure devices, e.g. from the FRITZ!Box integration (Internet access).

rules.title: Taking over & photos
rules.description: Siblings can take over open chores of others and get the points. Leave the time empty to turn it off.

data.photo_retention_days: Otherwise delete at the latest after (days)
data.photo_delete_after_review: Delete photos right after approving or rejecting

announcements.title: Speaker announcements
announcements.description: At these times Familienplan announces who still has open chores today. If everything is done, it stays quiet. Choose speakers plus a text-to-speech engine (e.g. Google Translate, Piper) or a service that speaks by itself (e.g. Alexa Media Player). Both work together.

data_description.announce_times: Comma separated, e.g. 17:00, 18:30. Leave empty to turn off.

ages.title: How old are the children?
ages.description: Age in years. Each child only gets chores that suit their age and automatically moves into new chores as they grow older. You can leave it empty.

pro.title: Familienplan Pro
pro.description:
{state}

Free: chores, points, rewards, reminders.
Pro: internet lock, photo proof, taking over chores, speaker announcements, absence with substitute.

You get the key by e-mail after purchase. It is activated online once, after that everything runs locally.

data.license_remove: Release the key here (e.g. before moving to new hardware)

error.invalid_member: Name missing or this user is already linked to a member.
error.tts_missing: Please also choose a text-to-speech engine for the speakers.
error.shop_not_ready: Sales are not set up yet. Keys cannot be activated yet.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the license server. Please try again later.
error.key_unknown: This key does not exist. Please enter it exactly as in the e-mail.
error.too_many_activations: The key is already active on too many devices. Release it there first.
error.key_revoked: This key is no longer valid.

options.delete: Delete right after we approve or reject (recommended)
options.keep: Keep for 7 days, then delete automatically
